b: As long as I can remember I've never been affectionate. I cringe hugging people hello or goodbye. Growing up I never said I love you to any of my family or friends, not because I didn't love them it just felt odd to say. Until I met my husband I thought I was broken but I find it very easy to be affectionate with him. Cuddlings, hugs, kisses, holding hands.... You name it.

When our first daughter was born all I could do was kiss her and practically absorb her lol. I EBF and didn't have any issues showing affection but as she got older (passed the age of 2) I started to feel odd when she would go out of her way to show affection to me. Hugging her back or giving her a kiss would ick me out more and more. When my second daughter was born the same thing happened where I had no issues but as she's getting older I'm starting to struggle more and more.

I do want to say I always return their affection and go out of my way to give them hugs and cuddles because I feel like that's a very important way of showing love to a young child. I'm also very cautious to make sure I'm not showing favorites when it comes to physical affection between them two.
I just don't understand WHY I'm like this. I love them so much I could sit here crying about how much I miss them and they are only napping lol so why do I feel so icked out just from a simple hug?
My mom said when I was little I was very affectionate so I don't know when this happened
